name: TAF Monthly Eligibility File
description: The TAF Monthly Eligibility file contains monthly eligibility records for individuals enrolled in Medicaid or CHIP. Each record captures a beneficiary's eligibility status, enrollment group, managed care participation, and dual Medicare/Medicaid enrollment status for a given month within the reference year. Note: not all states are available in TAF data from 2014-2015, as this was a transition period between MAX and TAF. From 2016-2018, all states are available.

license.name: No license, user must be under Data User Agreement (DUA)

name: TAF Monthly Eligibility Records
description: Monthly eligibility records from the CMS T-MSIS Analytic Files (TAF). Each row represents a beneficiary's enrollment status for a given calendar month, capturing eligibility group, managed care enrollment, dual eligibility, and coverage details. Multiple rows per beneficiary per year (one per month enrolled).

content.bene_id: String: BENE_ID. Encrypted CCW beneficiary identifier assigned by the Chronic Conditions Warehouse to uniquely identify individuals across CCW Medicare and Medicaid data.
content.msis_id: String: MSIS_ID. Encrypted state-assigned beneficiary unique identifier used to identify a Medicaid or CHIP enrollee and related claims.
content.year: String: RFRNC_YR. Reference year for the data file.
content.state_cd: String: STATE_CD. Submitting state postal abbreviation for the state that submitted the enrollment record.
content.bene_state_cd: String: BENE_STATE_CD. State FIPS code for the beneficiary home or mailing address, using the most recent available value.
content.bene_zip_cd: String: BENE_ZIP_CD. ZIP code for the beneficiary home or mailing address, using the most recent available value.
content.bene_cnty_cd: String: BENE_CNTY_CD. ANSI county numeric FIPS code for the beneficiary home or mailing address, using the most recent available value.
content.submitting_state: String: SUBMTG_STATE_CD. Submitting state entity code: the ANSI FIPS numeric code for the U.S. state, territory, or District of Columbia that submitted the data.
content.filename: String: FILENAME. Likely a local engineering or provenance field storing the source file name.
content.month: Int32: MONTH. Likely a local month index used to reshape monthly codebook variables such as *_01 through *_12 into long format.
content.mdcd_enrlmt_days: Float64: MDCD_ENRLMT_DAYS_01-12. Number of days of Medicaid enrollment in the month, including traditional Medicaid and Medicaid Expansion CHIP (M-CHIP).
content.chip_enrlmt_days: Float64: CHIP_ENRLMT_DAYS_01-12. Number of days of CHIP enrollment in the month.
content.chip_cds: String: CHIP_CD_01-12. Monthly code distinguishing Medicaid, Medicaid Expansion CHIP, and Separate CHIP populations.
content.rstrctd_bnfts_cd: String: RSTRCTD_BNFTS_CD_01-12. Monthly restricted benefits code indicating the scope or limitation of benefits applicable in the month.
content.dual_elgbl_cd: String: DUAL_ELGBL_CD_01-12. Monthly Medicare-Medicaid dual eligibility code indicating dual coverage status for beneficiaries entitled to Medicare and eligible for some category of Medicaid benefits in the month.
content.elgblty_grp_cd: String: ELGBLTY_GRP_CD_01-12. Monthly eligibility group code applicable to the beneficiary based on the eligibility determination process.
content.masboe_cd: String: MASBOE_CD_01-12. Monthly maintenance assistance status and basis of eligibility code.
content.state_spec_elgblty_grp_cd: String: STATE_SPEC_ELGBLTY_GRP_CD_01-12. Monthly state-specific eligibility group code: the composite of eligibility mapping factors used to create MAS/BOE values before 2014 and eligibility-group values on or after 2014.
content.mc_plan_type_cd: String: MC_PLAN_TYPE_CD_01_01-16_12 / MC_PLAN_TYPE_CD_01-12. Managed care plan type code indicating the type of managed care arrangement for a month, with up to 16 plan type occurrences per month.
content.elgblty_chg_rsn_cd: String: ELGBLTY_CHG_RSN_CD_01-12. Reason for change in eligibility status reported when there is a change in an individual's eligibility status; in later releases it captures reason for complete loss or termination of Medicaid or CHIP eligibility.
